name: Bitou Vineyards
description_short: Wine estate restaurant serving Mediterranean-inspired fare with sweeping Bitou Valley views near Plettenberg Bay.
description_long:
Perched in the Bitou Valley just off the N2, Bitou Vineyards offers a peaceful escape with panoramic views of rolling hills and vineyards. The restaurant serves Mediterranean-inspired dishes that pair beautifully with their estate wines, making it an ideal stop between Knysna and Plettenberg Bay.

The menu focuses on fresh, locally-sourced ingredients with options ranging from wood-fired pizzas to seasonal mains. Settle onto the terrace with a glass of their Sauvignon Blanc or Rosé and take in the valley views. The relaxed atmosphere works equally well for families exploring the Garden Route or couples seeking a leisurely lunch.

While the vineyard is still establishing itself, the setting alone makes it worth the detour. It's a proper working farm with tastings available, and the restaurant provides honest country cooking without pretension. Book ahead on weekends when locals and visitors alike come for the views and the easy-going vibe.
